capabilities.note: full list with risk classes in the contract module; capability list from the upstream README (fetched 2026-10-20)

governance.codeExec: execute_blender_code is arbitrary Python inside Blender — founder-tap-gated per call, and BLENDER_MCP_SAFE_MODE=1 is pinned so scripts are validated before they run
governance.egress: generate_3d / search_assets / import_asset reach third-party services; each capability declares its services and a call is refused unless every service is on the session's declared egress list
governance.socket: the addon channel binds BLENDER_HOST=localhost only — a non-localhost host is refused at contract build
governance.telemetry: DISABLE_TELEMETRY=true is PINNED in the launch env — upstream collects a minimal anonymous usage record (install id, session id, tool name, success, duration, versions, OS, timestamp) by default; the governed build collects nothing

licensePosture.distribution: connector run by the operator via uvx; Kingmaker ships the descriptor + contract only
